Name: Aymeric de Borel - FFXIV
Author: Adaire99
Description:
[b][u][size=2]Summary:[/size][/u][/b]
This mod adds Aymeric de Borel from Final Fantasy XIV to Stardew Valley! Aymeric is a new, custom NPC, and does not replace any existing villagers. He is a marriageable bachelor with over 400 lines of dialogue, six unique heart events, and a custom map and spouse room. He also attends festivals, visits the Island Resort, offers a Community Board quest, and more! Aymeric is a Content Patcher modpack, so [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] must be installed for it to function.

[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
This mod does include a custom house for Aymeric, located on the Cindersap Forest map. This means it will conflict with mods such as Stardew Valley Expanded that also feature an alternate Forest map. If you wish to use this mod alongside SVE, please download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23851]SVE Compatible Version[/url]﻿. Aymeric will also conflict with any other custom NPCs that occupy the same location in the Cindersap Forest, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9222]Eugene[/url]. If you wish to download a version compatible with Eugene, please see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23851]SVE Compatible Version[/url]

[b][u]Portraits:
[/u][/b]The incredible [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/about-me?gameId=1303]Poltergeister[/url]﻿ has uploaded a stunning [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24347]Slightly Cuter Aymeric[/url]﻿ portrait mod, featuring an array of seasonal and festival outfits that are guaranteed to knock your socks off! Please check it out if you're looking for some professional-grade portraits and sprites!  

[b][u]Known Issues/Missing Features:[/u][/b]
- Aymeric currently will not attend another NPC's wedding (if, for example, the farmer marries Abigail or another villager).
- Aymeric is currently missing Winter portraits and sprites, added with the 1.6 update.
- If Aymeric is being added to a previously-existing save rather than a new one, there will likely be bushes or logs spawned inside his house in the Cindersap Forest. With the 1.6 update, this can cause issues, with unbreakable bushes spawning in Aymeric's scheduled path. For this reason, it is recommended to either start a fresh save with the Aymeric mod, or to utilize a mod like [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases]Reset Terrain Features[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] to remove any problematic bushes.
- Aymeric's 14-heart event can be interrupted if a certain summer weather event occurs in the middle of it. The event should proceed as normal afterwards. Unfortunately, I'm not sure of a way to fix this :(

[b][u]Feedback:[/u][/b]
For any bug reports or general feedback, feel free to comment here or message me [url=https://twitter.com/celestial_tart]@celestial_tart[/url]﻿ on Twitter! This is my first time ever taking on a project like this; I'm a writer by trade, not a coder, so there are bound to be some mistakes, and I'd love to fix them wherever they crop up. 

[b][u]Gift Tastes:[/u][/b]
If you want information on Aymeric's gift tastes, event triggers, schedule, and more, please visit this Google Doc: [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1wWpEXWN2Pb6ybrpqyHly9JbcQfzG4EHReKbcG2xs4D8/edit?usp=sharing]Stardew Aymeric Info[/url]

Thank you for giving my mod a try, and I hope you enjoy having Aymeric in your game!
